title: MCP Toolbox older protocol handlers omit per-tool OAuth scope checks
summary: A low-privilege authenticated client can invoke higher-privilege tools by selecting an older MCP protocol or omitting the version header. The CVE identifies version 1.3.0; the vendor includes centralized scope validation in release 1.4.0.

severity.rationale: An authenticated client can bypass the intended tool authorization boundary and reach privileged data operations. Possessing a low-privilege token is a meaningful precondition, but scoped agent database access needs prompt correction.

affected.note: The CVE identifies exactly 1.3.0 as affected; no broader affected range is asserted. Release 1.4.0 includes the scope validation fix.

exposure: Requires authenticated access and tools restricted by scopesRequired. Vulnerable handlers are 2025-06-18, 2025-03-26 and 2024-11-05; omitting the header selects the latter.

params.instructions: Check for MCP Toolbox 1.3.0 and verify the deployed build includes the centralized scope validation shipped in 1.4.0.

remediation.details: Install MCP Toolbox 1.4.0 or a later release containing the centralized scope validation fix. Do not rely on clients voluntarily selecting the newer protocol.
remediation.risk: Medium. Restart affected sessions and validate dependent workflows.

verification: With a low-scope test token, verify privileged tool calls are denied for every supported protocol and with the version header omitted.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review.
